summary: Bridgecrest Auto Funding LLC, as depositor, filed a routine Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, tied to the October 8, 2026 issuance of Class A-1 through Class D publicly registered auto loan asset-backed notes by Bridgecrest Lending Auto Securitization Trust 2026-4, sponsored by Bridgecrest Acceptance Corporation. The filing satisfies an undertaking to furnish unqualified legality and tax opinions, attached as Exhibits 5.1, 5.2 and 8.1 from Mayer Brown LLP and Morris James LLP. No deal terms, pricing, ratings, collateral pool data or board recommendation are disclosed. This is an ordinary securitization takedown, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle arises.
